title: dsHOME
description: Advanced Minecraft homes plugin with GUI, teleport system, and 70 home support.
body:
dsHOME — An Advance Minecraft Home Plugin

Key Features
GUI Management: Manage up to 70 homes across a 5-page, easy-to-use interface.
Flexible Teleportation: Teleport instantly via the GUI or by name with /home <name>.
Customization: Configurable teleport delays, particle effects, sounds, and messages with full hex color support.
Safe & Secure: Features a teleport countdown with movement cancellation and a confirmation screen for deleting homes.
Admin Tools: View and teleport to any online or offline player's homes, and reload the plugin in-game.
Granular Permissions: Home slots are controlled by individual permissions (xhomes.home.1-70).
Core Commands
Player Commands:

/homes or /h: Opens the main homes GUI.
/sethome <name>: Sets a home at your location.
/delhome <number>: Deletes a home.
/home <name>: Teleports to a named home.
/home rename <old> <new>: Renames a home.
Admin Commands:
/homes help: Displays all commands.
/homes reload: Reloads the configuration file.
/homes see <player>: Views an online player's homes.
/home offlinesee <player>: Views an offline player's homes.
/home tp <player> <home>: Teleports to a player's home.
Permissions:
xhomes.home.1 - 1 home permission
xhomes.home.2 - 2nd home permission
....
xhomes.home.70 - 70th home permission
